_comment: Fictional demonstration stores selling real Philippine-market brands, for the capstone demo. Single source for App\Domain\Demo\DemoVendorMarketplace, tools/demo-assets/generate_demo_vendor_assets.py (logos, sample documents) and tools/demo-assets/fetch_demo_photos.py (photos). Prices are PHP retail prices observed at Philippine online hardware stores in October 2026; the seeder converts them to centavos. Store names, owners, staff, TINs, IDs and phone numbers are fictional. A product's compliance block names a real PS License No. or ICC sticker serial from the DTI-BPS registers in materials/ (List of PS Licensees, List of ICC Certificate Holders); the seeder verifies it through the register lookup, never by writing a decision directly.
